verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Qualcomm serves an llms.txt at qualcomm.com (HTTP 200), so an agent has an agent-oriented entry point. However, it appears to be a company-level overview, the markdown docs variant returns 404, and the X2 Elite spec page serves only a JavaScript shell to non-browser fetchers, which limits agent use. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme or developer docs, markdown/agent-readable doc pages, crawler-readable spec pages, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.qualcomm.com/llms.txt #  Qualcomm Incorporated
